items.source: This class implements a runtime environment check for obtaining the appropriate weaver implementation, including Spring's VM agent and any ClassLoader supported by Spring's ReflectiveLoadTimeWeaver.
items.translation: 该类实现了运行时环境检查，以获取适当的织入实现，包括Spring 的 VM agent以及 Spring 的 ReflectiveLoadTimeWeaver所支持的任意ClassLoader。

items.source: Should not return the same instance of the ClassLoader returned from an invocation of LoadTimeWeaver.getInstrumentableClassLoader().
items.translation: 不应返回从LoadTimeWeaver.getInstrumentableClassLoader()调用中返回的ClassLoader的同一实例。

items.source: Typically registered for the default bean name "loadTimeWeaver"; the most convenient way to achieve this is Spring's <context:load-time-weaver> XML tag or @EnableLoadTimeWeaving on a @Configuration class.
items.translation: 通常注册为默认 Bean 名称"loadTimeWeaver"；实现此目标最方便的方式是使用 Spring 的<context:load-time-weaver>XML 标签或在@Configuration类上使用@EnableLoadTimeWeaving。

items.source: May be the current ClassLoader, or a ClassLoader created by this LoadTimeWeaver instance.
items.translation: 可能是当前的ClassLoader，或由该LoadTimeWeaver实例创建的ClassLoader。
